domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

18.4.0 release acceptance, round 1, record R-OWED of wave anchor #32908: the owed-retest list `release-18.4.0-w2-owed`. Two runner subagents (effort high) dispatched by the maintainer's project session, in one cold cloud container; text only.

**Result: 11/11 judged · 6 PASS / 5 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No planned item, no security finding, no product defect. **All 13 fix cards owed a retest on these 11 items HOLD.**

## Scope

`node scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` at 2026-11-12T23:11Z listed **19** owed rows (QA-sourced fix cards closed after the item's last verdict, which were records #32093, #32102 and #32135). This record judges the **11** that sit in no other set of this wave. The other 8 were judged at the same subject in sibling records of the same wave, and their fix cards are scored there:

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `main` @ `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` (2026-11-12); Console built from `ui/` in the same tree (`pnpm build --concurrency=2` 12m17s, then `pnpm console:build`).
- **Boots:** `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:/tmp/…`, `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported. R7 ports 41640–41653 (incl. plugin-email `startFakeSmtp` sink on 41647, a phone + 2FA boot, a production phone boot, a `--preset minimal` app-todo scratch boot, a writable showcase copy); R2 ports 41535 and 41537 for the three browser retests. One file DB per item.
- **Personas:** seeded admin, seeded Mei (`phone.demo@example.com`), members by admin create-user + change-password; identity proved with get-session before each persona's cells. Browser sign-in through the form.
- **Hygiene:** every port free at the end, `git status` clean, nothing in `installed-packages`. A container restart at about 23:25Z killed every process; captured verdicts were kept and boots re-made.
- **Time:** R7 23:14Z → 23:52Z (about 12 min environment, 26 min testing).

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

About 9 runner-minutes on the same boots (admin, Mei, members, anonymous): meta-save If-Match edges and `_drafts` parameters; data door blank/unknown ids and bad bodies; automation anonymous, blank and wrong-flow run ids; notify cross-user mark-read and bad `ids`; email template notify to a non-user address; auth unknown phone, empty password, wrong or empty TOTP, missing two-factor cookie; approvals request ids unknown/blank/not-a-party. **Nothing filed.**

## Checklist-accuracy notes and fixture gaps (for anchor #32908, not extracted)

- automation.trigger-status-contract acceptance[5]: the "node edited away" arm is stale; since #28405 a resume uses the body the run started on (measured: 200, completes on the old body). Only the deregistered-flow arm answers 404 RUN_NOT_FOUND.
- automation.trigger-status-contract: RESUME_CHILD_PENDING is stageable with two runtime flows (map over a screen item flow); worth a recipe line. qa-flow-status-doors knownGaps[1] step 2 is now proven live and can drop "read from code".
- integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery acceptance[4]: `sys_notification` and `sys_notification_delivery` live in the telemetry DB; the count should name both files. #32143 residual: the trigger response's `summary.nodes[]` notify row carries no warning.
- integration-system.email-template-render knownGaps[1]: an email template send to a non-user address fails the step by design.
- identity-auth.auth-method-matrix acceptance[9]: the 404 arm of `delete-user/callback` needs `?token=`; without it the query schema answers 400. Clauses [0], [4], [5] mix drivable variants with blocked SSO/device rows; splitting them would let a run score cleanly.
- api-backend.error-envelope-ledger: the plain-object comparand INVALID_FILTER face (404-char message, no hint) remains, declared a control by PR #32332; the anchor may want a ruling on whether #32169 item 2 covers it.
- ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names acceptance[0]: carve out the position half of `sys_user_position`'s title per ruling A on #32106.
- plugin-email testkit: `startFakeSmtp` takes no port option.

The per-clause tables follow as comments (R7 verbatim; R2's retest section verbatim).
